title: SpellCore Focus Manual
summary: Cast starter spells with focus discipline, core requirements, aether costs, and cooldown awareness.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: SpellCore owns active spellcasting, focuses, loadouts, cooldowns, and aether costs. The current slice makes Signal Focus casting playable with starter spells.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Craft a Signal Focus, carry an awakened spell core when required, cycle spells while sneaking, and cast only when the cooldown and aether cost make sense.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Choose a starter spell, confirm cost and cooldown, cast server-side, read the result, then wait or reposition before casting again.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Signal Focus, awakened spell cores, selected spell state, aether costs, cooldowns, starter spell definitions, and HUD mirrors keep casting readable.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: RitualCore can awaken spell cores, Arcane Index explains spell records, Grimoire adds warning context, and MissionCore can record casting objectives.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If casting fails, check selected spell, awakened core requirements, aether availability, cooldown, server authority, and optional RitualCore status.
